acceptanceCriteria: skip with a trailing if/unless inside an example is reported with a conditional-skip reason (test)
filter_run_excluding tags in spec_helper.rb mark matching examples with a config-skip reason (test)
A TSA requirement is added; focused tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1798 (PR #1150). Hygiene INELIGIBLE detection sees only literal skip/pending/x*/f* declarators and metadata on the declaring line. `skip ... if ENV[...]` inside an example and `config.filter_run_excluding` in spec_helper are not seen, so an example that may not run is reported eligible. Expected: these are detected, or the result is downgraded to an advisory/unknown reason rather than clean.
title: RSpec hygiene misses conditional and config-driven skips (skip if ENV[...], filter_run_excluding)
